Commentary.Commentary: The New Zealand openers, Tom Latham and Tom Blundell will open the batting for New Zealand. The Indian players are out in the middle. Jasprit Bumrah will start the proceedings.
So, 242 on the board. A decent total one would feel if the Indian bowlers can striker early in this final session. Let's see how it pans out once the Kiwi openers come out to face the Indians.

Kyle Jamieson is down for a quick chat. He says that it is a special feeling to get to a 5-fer in front of the home crowd. Hagley Oval he mentions is very special as he has played a lot of cricket here. Further says that like Wellington the pitch has something for the fast bowlers and they are pretty satisfied with restricting India to 240 odd runs.

Earlier in the game, after being asked to bat, Indians did not start well but Shaw raked up an aggressive half ton and scored runs briskly. After his wicket, India lost the way and lost quick wickets before Pujara and Vihari crawled India back into the game with a 81-run stand. Apart from the three mentioned, who all got to their respective half tons, none of the Indian batters left any mark with the bat.

If it was Southee in the second session, Jamieson took the onus upon himself in this one as he ripped apart the Indian batting. He ended up with a fifer, his first in Tests to force the collapse. Boult removed Shami with a ripper to close the innings.

Wow! That was some collapse from the Indians. Vihari went just before the Tea. Pujara walked in with a new partner in Pant but it was all about wickets falling in quick succession as the session started. They lost 5 wickets for 45 runs in this session with 26 of those coming between Bumrah and Shami. Pant and Jadeja who had the responsibility of taking India towards a good total after a very good stand between Pujara and Vihari but they failed to do anything of note.

OUT! TIMBER! Boult finishes the innings with a ripper! Shami was probably thinking another bouncer but Boult dishes out a fuller and inswinging one. He tries to keep it out but is late in bringing his bat down. The ball goes behind and sends the off pole for a walk. INDIA ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 242.
The Physio walks out to the middle for the necessary concussion tests. He is looking fine though. And we are ready to go now.

Ouch! Shami is hit on the helmet. He takes it off and checks. Tells Boult that he is fine. Shami backs away for another slog but the bowler follows him. He tries to pull but misses to get hit on the helmet.

SIX! Back to back sixes now and Shami and Bumrah are adding valuable runs for India. Boult bowls one in the arc of Shami. He swings hard, connects and sends it sailing over wide long on for another maximum.
SIX! Connects this time and it goes all the way. Slightly short and around off, Shami hammers it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. That wasn't from the middle of the bat and goes over the ropes.
Bouncer on middle, this time it is Shami who tries to send it over the fence but fails to connect.
Length ball on middle, Bumrah goes for the slog again but the ball hits the inner half and goes towards square leg. They cross for a quick single.
Three more off the final ball. 9 from the over. Full and outside off, Bumrah squeezes it through gully and the batters run three.
Outside off, left alone.
Bouncer just outside off, Bumrah sways away from it.
A couple now as he pulls this short ball on middle down to deep mid-wicket. The fielder from the ring chases it down.
FOUR! He finally connects one and bags an important boundary. Length ball on middle, Bumrah flicks it past the leaping mid-wicket fielder and into the fence in the deep.
Swing and a miss again from Bumrah. A length ball just outside off, he goes for a mighty heave on the leg side but misses once again.
Full and outside off, Shami squeezes it towards gully.
Full and outside off, Shami looks to squeeze this one out but the ball hits the bottom part of the bat and then his hands. It rolls towards the off side.
Length ball on middle and leg, Shami looks to flick it to the leg side only to miss it and get hit high on the pads.
EDGY FOUR! Valuable runs! Length ball outside off, Shami goes to drive with hard hands but the ball takes a thick inside edge and races away to the fine leg fence.
Good length on off, pushed towards cover-point.
Fullish and around off, Shami drives it to covers.
And again! A length ball outside off, Bumrah throws his willow at it once again, only to miss out as the ball shapes away. Another wicket maiden from Jamieson.
Swing and a miss! Short one outside off, Bumrah throws his bat at it but makes no connection.
Beaten this time! Jamieson bowls this slightly short and just outside off. Bumrah comes forward and looks to force it towards the off side but misses.
Good length ball around off, Bumrah keeps it out.
Jasprit Bumrah is the last man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! First fifer for Jamieson in Tests and Jadeja perishes in search of quick runs! Jamieson is pumped up. Short ball on the body, Jadeja goes for the pull but ends up hitting it straight to fine leg off the top edge. Boult there dives forward and pouches the ball inches above the turf.
Shortish and around middle and leg, Jadeja keeps it out off his back foot.

Beaten! A length ball around off, it comes in with the angle as Shami tries to defend. He though is late in doing so as the ball sneaks through the gap between the bat and the pad. It goes over the stumps to the keeper.
Short and on middle, Jadeja plays a controlled pull towards deep square leg for a run. 1 ball for Shami to survive.
Now makes a leave to this length ball outside off.

FOUR! Clipped nicely! Jadeja is getting these important runs for India now. Boult sprays on the pads of Jadeja. All he needs to do is guide it to the fine leg fence. He does that nicely to bag consecutive boundaries.
FOUR! Hammered! Length ball around off, Jadeja comes down the track and lofts it over mid on for a boundary. Excellent shot and he will now look to score as many as he can.
Good length ball on middle, Jadeja keeps it out.
Mohammed Shami walks in to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust and India are tumbling once again. Slightly shorter ball outside off, Yadav is not one of those who will try to leave balls like these. He pokes at the ball but ends up getting a faint outside edge. The ball goes straight to the keeper and Watling will not miss out this one. A comfortable catch for him. 2nd wicket in the over and 4th in this innings for Jamieson.
Short and outside off, Yadav throws kitchen sink at it but fails to connect.
Good length ball around off, Yadav keeps it out.
Good length ball just outside off, Yadav thinks to push first but takes his bat away at the last moment.
Umesh Yadav is the new man in.

OUT! Dragged on! Another failure for Pant. He was looking itchy out in the middle, got a couple of chances in the last over but bottles it once again. It is a length ball outside off, Pant goes for the drive away from his body. The ball takes an inside edge and hits the stumps.
Full and around off, pushed towards mid off.
Short and on middle, Pant pulls it to fine leg for a run. End of an eventful over from Boult.
FOUR! Flicked with authority! Full and on middle, Pant whips it powerfully through mid-wicket for a boundary.

EDGY FOUR! Another reprieve! Shortish and around off, Pant hops and tries to defend but the ball takes a thick outside edge and flies between the keeper and the first slip fielder and into the third man fence.

Dropped? Yes, de Grandhomme is the man. A length ball on middle, Pant looks to flick but the ball hits the upper part of his willow and goes towards de Grandhomme at mid-wicket. He lunges forward to pouch but the ball hits his fingers and does not stick. That can be a costly drop, if Pant can whack a few and take India towards 250 or more.
Full around off, Pant pushes it to mid off.
Landed around off on a good length, Pant taps it towards point.
Shortish and on middle, Jadeja works it towards square leg once again.
Another full ball on off and middle, Jadeja flicks again, finds square leg again.
On the pads of Jadeja now, he flicks but finds square leg.
On the pads, Pant clips it  behind square leg for a single.
Ravindra Jadeja is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! That is unusual way for Pujara to get dismissed. Jamieson gets the massive wicket of Pujara. Back of a length ball outside off, Pujara is one who ducks under these more often than not. He though this time goes for the pull. The ball takes the top edge and goes way in the air towards short fine leg. Watling calls for the catch, settles under it and gobbles it comfortably. A fighting innings from Pujara but he will be kicking himself for the way that he departs.
Jamieson starts with a shortish ball outside off, Pujara cuts but finds point.
Kyle Jamieson is back on. 10-1-35-1 are his figures so far.
Pant is off the mark with a couple! Full ball just outside off, Pant leans into the shot and drives it through mid off. Before the fielder can get to the ball, Pant gets a brace.
Length on off, defended towards covers.
Good length ball around off and middle, Pant comes forward and keeps it out.
Good length ball around off, Pujara clips it towards mid-wicket and takes a run.
Full ball around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and just outside off, Pujara plays a loose shot as he goes for the drive away from his body to get beaten.
Trent Boult with the ball from the other end. 12-2-51-1 so far from him.
Shortish and around off, Pant gets behind the line of the ball and keeps it out.
Very full ball on middle, Pant flicks it towards mid-wicket.

The Kiwi players are near the boundary ropes. The hosts now get into the huddle before they disperse to their positions out in the middle. Pujara has Rishabh Pant for the company to start post the Tea break. Wagner will finish the over in which he got rid of Vihari. Pant to face. Here we go...
... Day 1, Session 3 ...

Let's see what approach Pujara opts in the final session. Will Pant try to play his natural game or will he will try to rake up a partnership with Pujara? Or will Southee be able to take a fifer to bundle the Indians out. We will soon find out. Join us in a while for the last session.

Southee was once again brilliant with the ball, striking twice. Jamieson would feel that he was unlucky when Watling spilled an easy chance and gave a life to Vihari. Wagner kept bowling the shortish length and managed to remove Vihari just before Tea. They will now try to get a couple early and aim at the lower order of the Indian batting.

Southee once again removed the Indian skipper to begin the session on a high for the hosts. Rahane did not last long as he fell too to Southee. However, Pujara kept his end intact and then he got an able support from Vihari. The duo added 81 runs in 129 balls to take India close to 200. It will be interesting to see the approach of the Indian batters when they return for the final session.

Just at the stroke of the Tea, Vihari makes a mistake. He was going after the short balls and was scoring runs too but falls in the process. The way Indians were scoring runs, it looked like they will be able to win the session, even after losing a couple of big wickets in the form of Kohli and Rahane but this wicket means that the session is shared once again.

OUT! CAUGHT! A wicket right at the stoke of Tea. Wagner has the last laugh here. He keeps persisting with his short ball ploy and he reaps the reward for it. Once again Wagner bowls it short and on middle, Vihari shuffles across and looks to take on Wagner for the umpteenth time but he fails to get it off the middle of the bat. The ball takes the glove and goes towards the keeper where BJ Watling gobbles it and appeals and the umpire gives it out. Vihari departs after a promising knock and a good stand is broken. That will be TEA ON DAY 1!

Short of a length ball on off, Vihari goes for the pull but misses it.
FOUR! Short ball on middle, Vihari makes room and cuts it uppishly over point for a boundary. He also gets to his 4th Test fifty in the process.

Bouncer again, Vihari pulls it to deep square leg for a run.

FOUR! Runs coming thick and fast off the willow of Vihari. 4th boundary in 7 balls for him. Wagner dishes a bouncer down the leg side. Vihari rocks back and pulls it to fine leg and the ball races away to the fence.
Bouncer again. Pujara rolls it wrists and pulls it to deep square leg for a couple of runs.

Change of ends for Neil Wagner. 8-2-15-0 from him so far.

Another short ball and Vihari is happy to let it be.

Short ball on off, Vihari ducks under it.

Trent Boult is back on. 10-2-36-1 are his numbers so far.
Length ball on off, Vihari pushes it through covers for a single.

Full and on off, driven towards covers.

They started well picking up the wicket of the Indian skipper, Virat Kohli very early into the session and after a brief partnership, Southee picked up Rahane as well. The visitors are in a spot of bother yet again and they need Pujara and Vihari to steady the innings.

OUT! LBW! Plumb in front! Waste of another review from India! It is Kohli who has to walk back to the pavilion. Another failure for Virat on this tour. Full delivery to start from Southee on middle, swinging in. Kohli looks to drive but misses to get hit on the pads. Southee and the rest appeal and the umpire obliges with them as he raises the dreaded finger. Kohli discusses with Pujara and then decides to go for the review at the last moment. The Ultra Edge rolls in and it shows that there is no bat on it. The Ball Tracker shows that it will go onto hit the middle stump. Excellent start to the session for the Kiwis.
Kohli has been given out LBW! Kohli, after a discussion with Pujara has taken it upstairs. It looks plumb. Let's see what happens.
Tim Southee to bowl from the other end. 7-1-25-1 are his figures so far.

We are back for the second session. The New Zealand players are out in the middle. Cheteshwar Pujara and Virat Kohli will resume their innings. Trent Boult will start the proceedings after Lunch.
... Day 1, Session 2 ...

So, after the Lunch break, India will look to keep on getting the runs with minimal damage while the Kiwis would look to pick up wickets as quickly as possible. The session after Lunch promises to be another promising one. Join us for that at 1440 Local.

New Zealand, on the other hand, were not poor with the ball. They bowled tight lines and lengths and troubled the batters a bit but Prithvi Shaw played some delightful shots to their bowling. Boult has been impressive while Colin de Grandhomme was good in his opening spell. Kyle Jamieson was the other bowler to get into the wickets column as he picked up the wicket of Shaw. Tom Latham has to be credited for his wicket as he took a brilliant catch to send the half-centurion packing. Overall, the Kiwis will be happy with the session.

23 overs, 85 runs and two wickets. India have done a much better job with the bat so far than they did in the First Test. They would have been happier if they had not lost the wicket of Prithvi Shaw in the later half of the session. They started positively in this session with Shaw going all guns blazing at the start. Mayank Agarwal lost his wicket to Boult but then Shaw and Pujara stitched a good 50-run stand before Shaw was out to a brilliant catch from Tom Latham. Pujara has been defensive and has been joined by the Indian skipper, Virat Kohli who has looked good so far.
Full one outside off, Kohli shoulders arms to this one. LUNCH ON DAY 1.
Another full one on off, Kohli prods forward and defends it out to cover.
Full on middle, Kohli pushes it to mid off.
Good length ball on the pads, Pujara flicks it to fine leg and crosses over for a single.
Full delivery outside the off stump line, Cheteshwar lets the ball go to the keeper.
Full delivery on middle, Pujara flicks it to mid-wicket.
BEATEN! Excellent ball to end the over! Back of a length ball outside off, moving away from the batter. Kohli looks to defend but fails to get any bat on it.
Full on off, Kohli lunges forward and then defends it to the point region.
Length ball outside off, Kohli shoulders arms to it.
Back of a length ball outside off, Kohli lets the ball go to the keeper.
On off, pushed to the point region for a single.
Full delivery outside off, Pujara leaves the ball alone.
Good length ball on off, Kohli defends it to the point region.
Outside off, Kohli leaves the ball alone.
Good length ball outside off, Virat lets the ball go to the keeper.
Another full one, this time it is on the off stump line, Kohli lunges and blocks it to cover.
Full delivery outside the off stump line, Kohli makes a leave to this one.
Full delivery down the leg side, Kohli looks to flick but misses.
Tim Southee is back on. 5-1-24-0 are his figures so far.
Back of a length ball outside off, Cheteshwar lets it go to the keeper.
Fullish ball outside the off stump line, Pujara leaves the ball alone.
Outside off, left alone by Pujara.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Full delivery on middle, Kohli flicks it in style towards deep mid-wicket and picks up three before the fielder comes across and cleans it up with a dive.
Virat Kohli, is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Blinder of a catch from Tom Latham to end Shaw's brilliant innings. Shaw will be disappointed though as he had got a start and was looking in terrific touch out there. Full delivery outside off, Shaw looks to drive without moving his feet. It takes the outside edge and goes towards Latham at second slip. Latham jumps in the air and then plucks it out of thin air with his left hand. Brilliant piece of fielding and Shaw makes a long walk back to the pavilion.
Length ball on middle, CP flicks it to mid-wicket.
Good length ball outside off, Pujara leaves the ball alone.
Around middle, Shaw pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single. 50-run stand is up between the two.
Short ball down the leg side, Shaw ducks under it.

SIX! Risky way to get to his fifty! Second fifty for Shaw in Tests. Wagner dishes a short ball around middle and leg, Shaw pulls it over the deep square leg fielder for a maximum. Boult jumps but the ball goes over him. After a failure in the first Test, Shaw makes amends with a brilliant fifty.
Wagner starts with a short ball around middle and leg, Shaw ducks under it.
Neil Wagner is brought on for the first time today.
FOUR! Poor delivery from Jamieson! On a length on leg, Pujara flicks it easily towards fine leg for a boundary.
Full delivery on off, Pujara drives it through mid off. Williamson chases it and does well to stop it before the ropes. The batsmen get two runs.
On middle, Pujara flicks it to square leg.
On a length on middle, Shaw flicks it through mid-wicket. The batsmen get three runs.
BEATEN! Full and just outside off, Shaw looks to drive but misses it due to the inward movement on this one.
Full delivery on off, Shaw drives it to covers.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Length ball on middle, Cheteshwar works it to the leg side.
On middle, defended out.
Full on middle, Pujara defends it out off the front foot.
Good length ball outside off, Pujara shoulders arms to this one.

NOT OUT! Missing the stumps! Only the height could have saved Pujara and that is exactly what has happened here. Good length ball around middle, swinging in. Pujara surprisingly looks to leave it alone but gets hit on the pads. Colin de Grandhomme appeals but the umpire shakes his head. After a brief discussion with Williamson, the Kiwis take the review. The Ultra Edge and the Snickometer is shown to check whether there was any bat on it. No bat shows the replays. Is it surprising? No, Pujara had left the ball so there was a rare chance that it will hit the bat. The Ball Tracker rolls in and it shows that the ball was going over the stumps. New Zealand lose their review.
An LBW appeal has been taken upstairs. Pujara is the man in question. It looks close. He has left the ball alone so the impact would not matter. Let's see what happens.
Length ball on off, Shaw prods forward and then pushes it to the point fielder.
Good length ball on middle, Shaw flicks it to square leg.
On off, Prithvi solidly blocks it out.
Very full delivery down the leg side, Shaw looks to flick but misses to get any bat on it.
FIVE WIDES! Way over the keeper! Jamieson digs in a bouncer around middle, Shaw ducks under it. Watling hops and then tries to collect it but the ball flies over his head and into the fence.
Good length ball around off, Shaw looks to defend but it goes off the inner half towards square leg.
Very full delivery on middle, Shaw digs it out to the off side.
Good length ball on middle, Pujara blocks it out onto the pitch.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
EDGY! Good length ball outside off, Shaw looks to push it off the back foot but it takes the inside edge and goes past the leg stump and towards the fine leg region. The batters take a single.
Length ball on off, Shaw pushes it to cover off the back foot.
Doesn't carry! Good length ball outside off, Shaw looks to defend with hard hands but it takes the outside edge and lands just short of Southee at second slip.
Good length ball on middle, Prithvi works it to the leg side.
On middle, Cheteshwar flicks it to mid-wicket. Jamieson starts with a maiden.
BEATEN! Length ball outside off, Pujara looks to defend but misses to get any bat on it.

BEATEN! Beautiful from Jamieson! Just over the off stump! Good length ball around off, swinging in. Pujara looks to defend but the ball sneaks between his bat and pad and into the mitts of the keeper. It goes just above the off stump.
Full outside off, Pujara shoulders arms to this one.
Back of a length ball on off, Pujara stands tall and then defends it out onto the pitch.
Good length ball outside the off stump line, swinging away, Pujara looks to defend at first but then decides to leave it alone.
Kyle Jamieson is on.
FOUR! Nicely played! Fullish delivery outside off, Shaw punches it past the point fielder and into the fence.
On middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Good length ball around middle, Shaw looks to flick but misses to get hit on the thigh pad.
Well fielded! Shortish outside off, Shaw punches it crisply towards point where Blundell dives and makes a good stop. Saved a certain boundary.
Good length ball on middle, Shaw defends it out to the bowler.
FOUR! Nice way to start after the Drinks break! Full on middle, Shaw creams the drive past the bowler and into the fence for a boundary.

Drinks Break! India have started positively after being put into bat by the Kiwis. Shaw has looked good and has already hit 6 boundaries while Pujara has started off solidly. For the Kiwis, Boult looked good and was rewarded with a wicket of Mayank Agarwal. An interesting passage of play awaits.
Outside off, Pujara makes another leave to the keeper.
Good length ball on middle, Pujara defends it back to Boult.
Full delivery way outside off, Pujara has no problems in leaving it alone.
FOUR! Half volley and put away! It is bowled around off, Pujara drives it through mid off for a boundary. First one for him in this innings. 50 up for the visitors.
Length ball outside the off stump line, Cheteshwar lets the ball go to the keeper.
Good length ball on middle, Pujara defends it out.
FOUR! Creamed! Excellent shot from Shaw! Fullish outside off, Shaw leans forward and drives it through the cover region for a boundary.
Another full delivery down the leg side, Pujara tucks it to fine leg for a single.
Full on middle and leg, Prithvi flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Good length ball around middle and leg, Shaw looks to flick but misses to get hit on the thigh pad.
Good length ball on off, Shaw defends it off to the cover region.
Full delivery on off, Shaw drives it towards mid off.
Colin de Grandhomme is into the attack.
Length ball outside off, Pujara leaves the ball alone.
Pujara is off the mark off the thirteenth delivery! Full delivery outside off, Pujara drives it through the cover region and picks up a couple.
Good length ball outside off, Pujara leaves it alone.
Outside off, left alone.
LEG BYE! Good length ball on the pads, Shaw looks to flick but misses to get hit on the thigh pad. The ball rolls to the leg side and the batters steal a leg bye.

Just short! Shaw is really lucky here! Could have gone straight into the hands of the fielder at first slip. Good length ball outside off, Shaw, without moving his feet looks to push. It takes the outside edge and goes towards first slip. Southee, at second slip dives to his left but does not get a hand on it. Taylor moves to his right but the ball falls short of him as well.
Full delivery on middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
Full on off, Pujara lunges forward and then defends it out to mid off.
Good length ball around middle, Shaw pushes it to mid off and takes a single.
Southee bowls a bouncer around middle, Shaw ducks under it.
Good length ball outside off, Shaw shoulders arms to this one.
FOUR! Excellent timing from Shaw! Full on the pads, Shaw flicks it beautifully wide of the mid on fielder for a boundary.
Good length ball on off, Pujara defends it to cover.
Good length ball on middle, swinging in, Pujara works it uppishly, just past the short leg fielder.
Short ball outside off, Pujara sways away from it.
Fuller one on middle, Pujara is solid in defense and does so back to the bowler.
Full on middle, Pujara defends it out.
Full delivery on off, Pujara tucks it to mid-wicket.
On a length on off, Shaw pushes it to the mid off fielder.
BOUNCER! It is bowled around middle, Shaw ducks under it.
On middle, Prithvi pushes it to mid on.
Good length ball on off, Shaw defends it to the off side off the front foot.
Good length delivery on leg, Shaw looks to flick but gets hit on the pads.
On a length on off, Shaw punches it through point. The batsmen get two runs.
On a length on off, Cheteshwar blocks it out.
Good length ball on middle, Pujara defends it out onto the pitch off the back foot.
Cheteshwar Pujara is the new batsman in.

OUT! LBW! Three reds it is and Boult has struck the first blow for his side. Brilliant delivery from Trent Boult. New Zealand have struck early yet again. Full delivery on middle and leg, swinging in. Agarwal looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. Trent and the rest of his teammates put in an appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Agarwal discusses with his partner and then decides to go for the review. The Ultra Edge rolls in and it shows that there was no bat on it. The Ball Tracker is then shown. It shows that it is pitching in line and hitting the leg stump, sending Agarwal on his way back to the pavilion. He takes one review along with him as well.

Mayank Agarwal has been given out LBW and after a brief discussion with Prithvi Shaw decides to refer the LBW decision upstairs. There is no bat involved and the Ball Tracker shows that it was all reds.
Play and a miss! Nicely bowled from Boult! Full delivery outside off, Agarwal looks to play the drive but fails to make any connection with it.
Good length ball on middle, Agarwal tucks it to mid-wicket.
EDGY FOUR! Good length ball on middle, Agarwal looks to defend but it takes the outside edge and goes through the gully region for a boundary.
FOUR! Beautiful from Shaw! Southee overpitches this one on middle, Shaw drives it past the bowler through mid on for the second boundary of the over.
FOUR! Shaw is looking in fantastic touch! Back of a length ball outside off, Shaw stands tall and then punches it off the back foot to the cover fence for a boundary.
Full delivery on the pads, Agarwal flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full delivery around off, Mayank pushes it down to mid off.
Very full delivery outside off. It swings in after pitching but Agarwal watches it closely and lets it go to the keeper.
Full delivery on the pads, Agarwal works it to mid-wicket.
Length delivery around off, Shaw pushes it to cover off the back foot.
Good length delivery on middle, Shaw blocks it off the back foot to the bowler.
On the pads, Shaw looks to flick but misses to get hit on the thigh pad.
Another full delivery on middle, Shaw drives it past Boult, who gets a hand on it but fails to stop it and picks up a couple before the fielder comes across and cleans it up.
Full on middle, swinging in. Shaw blocks it out off the front foot to cover.
Good length ball on the pads, Agarwal works it to the deep square leg region for a single.
FOUR! Positive start from India! Short of a length outside off, Shaw rocks on his back foot and then punches it through the point region for a boundary.
Full on off, moving away from Shaw. Prithvi plays it towards mid off.
Very full delivery on off, Shaw pushes it to point.
Southee dishes a full delivery outside off, Shaw drives it through covers for another couple. Good positive start from Prithvi Shaw.
Creamed! Good length ball outside off, Shaw leans forward and drives it through covers. The fielder chases after it and cleans it up but does not stop the batters from taking two.
Good length delivery on off. It swings away and Shaw solidly defends it to the mid off region.
Length ball on the pads, Agarwal looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. 6 runs from the first over off Boult.
Good running! Length ball around off, Shaw defends it to cover and takes off for a quick single. They make it easily in the end.
Excellent bowling from Boult! Good length ball outside the off stump line, Shaw looks to defend but the ball whizzes past the outside edge of the bat and goes into the mitts of the keeper.
Fullish delivery outside the off stump line, Shaw shoulders arms to this one.

FOUR! Shaw is underway with a boundary! Good length ball outside off, Shaw gets to the pitch of the ball and then looks to push but it takes the outside edge and goes through the backward point region for the first boundary of the game.
India are underway! Boult starts with an inswinger on middle, Agarwal flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Trent Boult to bowl from the other end.
Good length ball outside off, Shaw pushes it to cover. Excellent start from Southee. A maiden to start off.
Good length ball on middle, Shaw flicks it to square leg. Shaw thinks of a single but is sent back by Agarwal. Of all things, India do not want a run out.
Full delivery on off, swinging away, Shaw prods forward and drives it to mid off.
Full delivery on middle and leg, Shaw pushes it to the mid on fielder.
Good length ball on middle, Shaw this time solidly defends it out back to the bowler.
Swing straightaway! Southee starts with a length ball on middle, swinging away. Shaw looks to play the flick but misses to get hit on the thigh pad. Good start from Southee.

We are all set to begin! The Kiwi players make their way out to the middle, after being in a huddle. Mayank Agarwal and Prithvi Shaw follow them out. Tim Southee will start for the hosts. 3 slips in place for him.
Both teams make their way out to the field for their respective National Anthems. First up is India's followed by the Kiwis.

Neil Wagner is now down for an interview who became a father recently. He says that it has been a pretty special week and it is nice to be back with the guys and play some Test cricket. Adds that he and his wife were watching the first game from the hospital and it was good to see the boys playing well. Goes onto say that he is looking forward to this game.

Ajinkya Rahane is down for an interview. He says that they were expecting it to rain today but it is good to see that it has cleared now. Adds that they are looking forward to this game. States that they got starts in Wellington and it is important that they get partnerships. Goes onto say that this wicket plays really well and there is more bounce on this wicket. States that they need to adjust to the conditions quickly.

Pitch report - Mark Richardson says that there is a lot of grass on this wicket.  Says that it will remain green for a long period of time. Adds that it is a spongy wicket with some moisture on it and it might take two days to harden up. Adds that it is not a great day to be a batsman on this wicket.

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Tom Latham, Tom Blundell, Kane Williamson (C), Ross Taylor, Henry Nicholls, BJ Watling (WK), Colin de Grandhomme, Kyle Jamieson, Tim Southee, Neil Wagner (In place of Ajaz Patel), Trent Boult.

India (Playing XI) - Prithvi Shaw, Mayank Agarwal, Cheteshwar Pujara, Virat Kohli (C), Ajinkya Rahane, Hanuma Vihari, Rishabh Pant (WK), Ravindra Jadeja (In place of Ravichandran Ashwin), Umesh Yadav (In place of Ishant Sharma), Mohammed Shami, Jasprit Bumrah.

Virat Kohli, the Indian skipper, says that they would have bowled first as well but they are ready to do the difficult. Says that Umesh Yadav replaces Ishant Sharma, who is facing an injury and Ravindra Jadeja comes in for Ravichandran Ashwin. Goes onto say that they need to find ways to score on this wicket.

Kane Williamson, the New Zealand skipper, says that they are going to have a bowl first. Adds that the pitch has a greenish tinge on it and they give a chance for the pacers early on. States that Neil Wagner comes in for Ajaz Patel. Goes on to say that there will be bounce on this wicket.
Toss - Time for the spin of the coin. New Zealand have won the toss and they choose to bowl first.

Greetings! Welcome to our coverage of the second Test match between India and New Zealand. After being thrashed in the first Test, India would hope that they perform better and level the series. Ishant Sharma might miss out as his ankle injury resurfaced and that will be a big blow. They are set to retain Shaw as the second opener despite having a poor first Test. New Zealand, on the other hand, were brilliant with the ball at the Basin Reserve and to further bolster their bowling attack, Neil Wagner has been added to the squad. Who will he replace? Ajaz Patel or Kyle Jamieson? Toss and team updates in a while.
